title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Maadili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds an article on the right shelf, reads it fully, and tells its main point from the examples that support it.

floor.prerequisite: Reads an article for its message.
floor.question: Makala haya yanahusu nini?

representations: an article with its paragraphs numbered
steps: Say the main point and one example.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads the article and writes its main point and one example.

misconceptions.ask: Matini hii ina wahusika na kisa, au inaeleza jambo?
misconceptions.repair: Makala hueleza jambo kwa ukweli; hadithi husimulia kisa cha wahusika.

listen_for: kwenye rafu ya hadithi za watoto
misconceptions.ask: Rafu hii ina vitabu vya aina gani?
misconceptions.repair: Makala hupatikana katika magazeti, majarida na vitabu vya maarifa.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii ni wazo kuu au ni mfano?
misconceptions.repair: Mfano huonyesha wazo kuu; si wazo kuu lenyewe.
Soma makala yote kabla ya kujibu.

checks.question: Ni ipi ni makala: shairi la heshima, makala ya "Faida za Usafi"?
Wazo kuu hutofautianaje na mfano?
checks.answer: wazo kuu ni jambo kuu; mfano unalionyesha
